==Description==
'''JingleBells''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that was obtained upon redeeming the [[Krampus' Revenge Event#Gifts|Gift of Carols]], which could have been achieved by collecting {{Cookies|1,500 Cookies}}. It was created by CapraKinetics. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote.

==Trivia==
*This emote is a based on [[wp:Jingle_Bells|Jingle Bells]], a song associated with Christmas.
